Lesson 1

Hand work to the agent

Pistachio's agent works inside the tabs you are already signed in to. You say what you want; it clicks, types, reads, and moves between pages — and stops before anything that matters.

  1. 1

    Open the chat with ⌘I

    The agent lives in the panel on the right. On any page, ⌘⇧D opens it with that tab already in hand.

  2. 2

    Ask in plain words

    “Find the three cheapest flights on this page and put them in a table.” “Reply to the top email saying I'll be late.” No commands to learn.

  3. 3

    Watch it work in your tab

    Every click, page, and specialist it brings in is listed as it goes, and a ring runs around the page while it drives. Interrupt any time by typing.

  4. 4

    It pauses before anything that changes the world

    A submit, a purchase, a message sent — the run stops with a card that says exactly what it is about to do. Approve it, reject it, or take over with your own hands and hand back when you are done.

  5. 5

    Replay what happened with ⌘E

    Every action is signed into an activity record you can read back, so a task is never a black box.

Try it now

Open the chat (⌘I) and ask: “Summarize this page in three bullets.”
